interface.signature: image: List[List[int]], sr: int, sc: int, newColor: int -> List[List[int]]

preconditions.description: The image dimensions are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= pixel <= 10 for row in image for pixel in row)
preconditions.description: All pixel values are within the specified range.
The starting coordinates are within the image bounds.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= pixel <= 10 for pixel in row) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: All pixel values in the returned image are within the specified range.
The starting pixel is filled with the new color.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i][j] == newColor if (abs(i - sr) + abs(j - sc) == 1 and image[i][j] == image[sr][sc]) else return_value[i][j] == image[i][j] for i in range(len(image)) for j in range(len(image[0])))
postconditions.description: All pixels connected 4-directionally to the starting pixel of the same color are filled with the new color.
